delete.description:
# Delete member by id and related all resource ## ✍️Pseudocode **Soft delete record each table in order:** 1. member_documents 2. member_business 3. membership_renewals 4. members :::highlight yellow 📌 If record has been deleted, it should not delete again (no update column `updated_at`, `deleted_at`) -- **API is idempotent** ::: > Execute under the same DB transaction ## Sequence diagram ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant browser as Browser participant nextjsapi as Next.js /api participant database as PostgreSQL autonumber browser->>nextjsapi: DELETE /api/v1/members/:id nextjsapi ->> nextjsapi: Validate path param break Invalid id (missing or <= 0) nextjsapi-->>browser: 400 Bad Request { error_message: "" } end rect rgb(235, 245, 255) Note over nextjsapi,database: Execute under Database Transaction (Atomic Soft Delete) nextjsapi->>database: BEGIN TRANSACTION Note over nextjsapi,database: 1. Soft delete documents (Idempotent: skips if already deleted) nextjsapi->>database: UPDATE member_documents
SET deleted_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW()
WHERE member_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL break Update fails nextjsapi->>database: ROLLBACK nextjsapi-->>browser: 500 Internal Server Error end Note over nextjsapi,database: 2. Soft delete business record nextjsapi->>database: UPDATE member_business
SET deleted_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW()
WHERE member_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL break Update fails nextjsapi->>database: ROLLBACK nextjsapi-->>browser: 500 Internal Server Error end Note over nextjsapi,database: 3. Soft delete renewals nextjsapi->>database: UPDATE membership_renewals
SET deleted_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW()
WHERE member_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL break Update fails nextjsapi->>database: ROLLBACK nextjsapi-->>browser: 500 Internal Server Error end Note over nextjsapi,database: 4. Soft delete member nextjsapi->>database: UPDATE members
SET deleted_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL break Update fails nextjsapi->>database: ROLLBACK nextjsapi-->>browser: 500 Internal Server Error end nextjsapi->>database: COMMIT database-->>nextjsapi: Success end Note over nextjsapi: Returns 200 OK regardless of whether
rows were actually updated or already deleted.
This guarantees idempotency. nextjsapi-->>browser: 204 No Content ```
